sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below shows the number of men and women in further education in Britain in three periods and whether they were studying fulltime or part-time. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
Some people spend a lot of money on sports and cultural events. Do you think this is this good or bad? Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
